decisions.reason: As a vegan superfood drink mix it is far from a chemicals firm's core process and engineering knowledge, so the firm has weak absorptive capacity to learn from early market signals and improve it competitively.

Modular waste-to-energy extensions fit the firm's existing chemical and process-engineering base and can benefit from learning across related plant products, even though the limited website prominence suggests only moderate commercial traction so far.

A waste-oil-to-energy plant is closely related to the firm's technological capabilities and was presented most clearly and consistently, which supports continued development and commercialization through accumulated learning.

Plastic-waste-to-fuel technology is adjacent to the firm's chemical conversion knowledge and likely improvable through in-house R&D and partnerships, despite still appearing less established than the waste-oil offer.
